title: Offline-First Reactive IndexedDB with Dexie.js
description: Enables uninterrupted POS checkout transactions during intermittent network disconnects by queuing writes in Dexie.js with atomic rollback.
benefit: Zero lost sales during cloud network outages, sub-10ms UI checkout responsiveness.

title: Dual-Mode Devil's Team Gatekeeper
description: Continuous non-blocking security telemetry during development paired with a strict blocking gate at deployment time for open critical findings.
benefit: Eliminates high-severity security breaches before they reach live enterprise client tenants.

title: Finite Numerical Boundary Guard for SaaS Pricing & Cart
description: Zod-powered runtime validation that rejects negative numbers, NaN, infinite floats, and exponential notation at the model boundary.
benefit: Prevents negative transaction balance attacks, infinite inventory generation, and calculation drift.

title: Client-Side Token Scrubbing & Memory Zeroization
description: Automatic redaction of PII and authorization headers before logging, canvas generation, or error reporting.
benefit: Prevents inadvertent leakage of enterprise customer credentials to third-party log aggregators.

title: Exponential Backoff Circuit Breaker for Third-Party SaaS Connectors
description: Wraps external API connectors (Jira, Slack, Notion) in a 3-strike circuit breaker with jittered exponential backoff and in-memory fallback.
benefit: Prevents downstream webhook/API latency spikes from hanging interactive user operations.
